note: The Equity Uprise 2025 fellowship cohort: nine people. Most are named on the City of Bridgeport proclamation 'Equity Uprise Human Rights Day' (Mayor Joseph P. Ganim, December 10, 2025); the proclamation prints a subset, and the founder confirmed the rest. Each entry records whether the proclamation names that person, so the document and the roster are never confused for each other. The founder has confirmed every person here agreed to be listed publicly under their own name. Nobody goes in this file on inference.

source.document: City of Bridgeport Proclamation — Equity Uprise Human Rights Day
source.quote: Equity Uprise 2025, a civic fellowship created by Bridgeport native Matthew McCluster and McCluster Corp, has brought together local artists, educators, technologists, and youth leaders
source.scanNote: The scan on file is cropped at the right margin, so line endings are lost. Names below come from the readable portion plus the founder's direct confirmation of each fellow's stage and legal name.
